description: This file is a renderer script for an Electron-based desktop application, managing window configuration, application startup, keychain migration, and event handling.

classes.name: DesktopDevice
classes.description: Represents a desktop device instance, created with configuration options including keychain usage and server host.

classes.name: CrossProcessBridge
classes.description: Handles communication between processes in Electron, managing window controls and app state.

methods.name: loadWindowVarsRequiredByWebApp
methods.description: Loads configuration variables into the window object for web app use.

methods.name: loadAndStartApplication
methods.description: Configures the window and initiates the application startup sequence.

methods.name: migrateKeychain
methods.description: Migrates keychain data from localStorage to native keychain if applicable.

methods.name: createDesktopDevice
methods.description: Creates a DesktopDevice instance with necessary configuration.

methods.name: configureWindow
methods.description: Sets up window controls and styles based on OS and user preferences.
